name: Computer use API
summary: A model API tool where the model looks at screenshots and returns mouse and keyboard actions with pixel coordinates. Your code runs the actions in a VM, container or browser and sends back the next screenshot.
how: Declare the provider's computer-use tool in the API call
Model returns actions such as screenshot, click at (x, y), type
Your app executes them in a sandboxed display
Return a new screenshot and loop until the task is done
facts: Anthropic computer use tool, OpenAI computer-use-preview, Gemini Computer Use
Any GUI, not just web pages
Works anywhere, but slower and costlier than DOM-based control
watchOut: Needs an isolated VM or container
Instructions in pages or images can hijack it
